artworks.title: Polander Leaning on a Stick
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing of a person in profile view, standing. The person is leaning on a stick, crossing their feet. Their face is turned away and mostly in shadow. They wear loose-fitting clothing, a hat with a high plume, and have a sword hanging from their waist. The background shows simple sketched lines suggesting foliage or trees.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Etching at a Window
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15.7 x 13 cm (6 3/16 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a desk. The man is facing the viewer, with both arms resting on the table. His facial features include a broad nose, slightly pronounced cheekbones, and a neutral expression. His hair is short and partially covered by a hat. He is wearing a textured coat or jacket with a white shirt collar. In front of him are papers or documents. There is a window in the background to the left, casting light on the man and the table. Above the man's head is a signature or inscription. The rest of the background is dark.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait in a Cap and Scarf with the Face Dark
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.6 x 10.7 cm (5 3/8 x 4 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with curly hair wearing a beret-style hat that covers part of their face. The person is facing the viewer with their head turned to the right. They have a mustache and wear a draped garment. The background is plain, and there is a signature that reads "Rembrandt f. 1633" at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Artist's Mother in a Cloth Headdress, Looking Down
artworks.description: The image is a detailed sketch of an older person, showing only the head and upper shoulders. The person is positioned facing slightly to the right, with their head slightly bowed. Their facial features include a furrowed brow and closed eyes, with textured skin that suggests age. The hair is mostly covered by a large, loose hood or a headscarf that drapes around the head and down the sides. The sketch is monochrome, created with fine lines to suggest depth and texture. The background is unadorned, consisting of a simple, light-toned wash that makes the subject stand out. Above the head is the inscription "Rembrandt. f. 1633," indicating the artwork's origin.

artworks.title: The Artist's Mother Seated, in an Oriental Headdress
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman seated and facing slightly to the right. Her head is in profile view and she has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and cheekbones. She has long hair pulled back with some strands falling behind her. She wears a textured garment, possibly fur or velvet, with a high collar. Her hands are folded in her lap. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Peter in Penitence
artworks.description: The image is a sketch that shows a man in profile, kneeling on one knee. His head is turned to the side, displaying his face with a round nose and a full beard. He has short, tousled hair and is wearing flowing robes. His left hand rests on a staff, and in his right hand, he holds an open book. The background consists of sketch-like marks that suggest a textured or natural setting. The signature of the artist and the date "1625" are visible at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Les Amours Conduisant le Monde (Love Turning the World)
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling lines and circular shapes forming an abstract representation of a large spherical object. Figures are seen interacting with the sphere, set against ethereal, cloud-like forms in the background.

artworks.title: Jean Charles Folard
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. The man is positioned three-quarters towards the left. He has a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, and a slightly pointed nose. His hair is styled in grayish-white tight curls. He is wearing a dark blue coat with gold embroidery, a white shirt, and a dark cravat. The background is a muted, dark shade, and the portrait is within an oval frame.

artworks.title: The Lute Player and the Drinker
artworks.artist: Wallerant Vaillant after David Teniers the Younger
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.5 x 31 cm (10 13/16 x 12 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men. The first man, sitting on a low stool, plays a lute. He wears a hat, a tunic, and loose breeches. The other man stands behind him, holding a wine glass. He wears a broad-brimmed hat and a belted garment with long sleeves. On a table beside them is a jug.

artworks.title: The First of September, Morning
artworks.description: This is a painting of a stable interior featuring several animals and figures preparing for an outing. The scene is set in a rustic barn with wooden beams and hay scattered on the ground. A horse stands prominently towards the center, fully saddled and ready, while another horse feeds from a haystack in the background. Two dogs are also present, one being petted. The dim interior is lit by light streaming through an open window, illuminating a cat perched on the windowsill. A broom can be seen resting against the wall.

artworks.title: The First of September, Evening
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people and animals in a rural setting. To the left, two men are seated on a bench next to a building with a thatched roof. The man on the left is shown mostly in profile, wearing a brown suit and dark hat, with one hand resting on his knee. The other man stands, holding up a large fish with a smile; he is dressed in a red waistcoat and dark coat. Between them stands a small girl with curly hair, wearing a white dress, gazing upwards. There are two dogs beside the bench, one lying down and the other seated. To the right, a person in a long coat and hat is leading a saddled horse away from the building, shown from behind and slightly turned away. A woman is visible through a lattice window of the building, wearing a bonnet and gazing out. There is a wooden sign hanging above the doorway, displaying a painted emblem or animal. The background shows a cloudy sky, with the landscape suggesting a countryside, and the surrounding area is grassy with a few plants visible.

artworks.title: Landscape with the Circumcision of Moses' Son
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a stream winding through it, leading towards a stone bridge. The horizon is visible in the distance through the arch of the bridge. The artwork uses intricate etching with fine lines to define textures of foliage, water, and stone. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of gray and black. In the foreground, figures engage in activities near the water, surrounded by trees and a rustic building.

artworks.title: Study
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a woman standing in profile view, turned slightly to the right. Her posture is relaxed, with her right arm bent and hand resting on a ledge or rail, and her left arm extended, lightly grasping a vertical structure. Her facial features are depicted with delicate lines, capturing a serene expression, and her short hair appears to be tucked neatly under a headscarf or wrap that covers her head. She is dressed in a flowing, draped garment with crossing lines over the chest, suggesting a classical style. The background is simple and unadorned, focusing attention on the figure.

artworks.title: Chapel Doorway, Montresor
artworks.medium: etching in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 17.6 × 12.6 cm (6 15/16 × 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate doorway and part of a building's facade. The detailed line work depicts a classical doorway with a pediment adorned with decorative sculptures and a large door. The door features the visible text "MUSET AR DE CL" on its surface. The architectural style suggests a historic or traditional setting. The surrounding area shows rough, sketchy line work. To the left, a small figure is sketchily drawn. The overall style portrays an old architectural study of period architecture.

artworks.title: J.B. Faure
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man's upper body in profile. He is facing right with his mouth open, suggesting he is speaking or singing. He has a full beard, wears a cap, and his hair is neatly tucked underneath. He is dressed in a suit jacket with a bowtie around his collar. His hands are above a keyboard, possibly playing a piano or organ. The background features textured lines creating an abstract backdrop.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: woodcut,  hand-colored in light and dark blue, red, green, yellow, orange, lavender and gold
artworks.description: The image features two figures: a woman seated with a child in her lap. The woman has light skin, long blonde hair, and delicate facial features. She wears a red cloak over a blue and white robe. The child has light skin and curly blonde hair, is unclothed except for a small white cloth, and is held close by the woman. The background consists of black and white wavy lines, framed by a rectangular border with colorful floral patterns in red, blue, and green. Below the main image is decorative script in red and blue ink on a light background.

artworks.title: Talia (Thalia)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on the ground. The individual is in a three-quarter view, with their head turned to the right and slightly tilted back. The person has a serene expression, closed eyes, smooth skin, long wavy hair flowing down their back, and is wearing draped clothing, revealing a bare shoulder and part of their legs. They hold a small stringed instrument against their shoulder. The background displays a landscape with rolling hills and trees, framed by a border of foliage along the bottom edge.

artworks.title: The King's Son
artworks.description: The image features a detailed, monochrome scene with men in renaissance clothing, including one on horseback to the left, with a landscape of hills, buildings in the distance, and a figure under a tree on the right. Patterns, textures, and swirling clouds are depicted in detailed linework, creating a play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Young Innkeeper
artworks.description: The image shows three people in a dimly lit setting. One person stands wearing a robe-like garment, facing left with their head turned right. They have curly hair tied up and wear loose-fitting clothing. The second person, seated on an overturned barrel, is in profile wearing a hat and hunched over an object that looks like a bowl. The third person stands next to the first, facing them with aged skin, a long nose, and a soft rounded hat. The background features shadows, a wooden bench to the left, and a plain wall to the right. The scene is illustrated in a monochromatic style, capturing a moment of interaction.

artworks.title: Autumn
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Hans Bol
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with people engaging in various work activities, including pig butchering and food preparation. In the background, there are rolling hills, a village with buildings, a church with a spire, a windmill, and houses with thatched roofs. The sky is clear with the sun shining. The artwork is detailed with fine linework in a sepia-toned palette, capturing an autumnal setting.

artworks.title: Winter
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Hans Bol
artworks.description: The image shows a winter scene with a village on the horizon, a castle near a frozen water body, and people engaged in various activities such as warming by a fire, working together, playing on the ice, and participating in a small gathering or market. There are children playing on the ice, and the scene is depicted in a monochromatic style with detailed etching, emphasizing textures and movement.

artworks.title: Hercules and the Cretan Bull
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and carrying a bovine animal over his shoulders. The man is in profile, facing downwards towards the animal. He has defined facial features, short curly hair, and is nude, displaying a muscular build. His left hand supports the bovine's neck, while his right hand rests on its back leg. The background is simple, and the overall tone is monochrome with detailed shading to accentuate the forms of the man and the animal.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed scene with a bird's-eye view. The horizon line is low, marked by a line of trees and buildings in the distance, where a castle-like structure and village elements are visible. The brushstrokes are finely detailed with intricate line work. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Several figures are tending to a large garden space, and beyond, domestic activities and pastoral scenes can be seen. In the background, buildings and trees create the sense of a thriving countryside extending towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Summer
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling harvest scene with figures cutting and bundling grain. Detailed depictions of scythes and sheaves are visible. In the background, there are small buildings, a church steeple, and dense trees forming a boundary. The engraving technique uses precise lines to convey texture and movement, with a limited grayscale color palette. Figures in the distance work under a stylized sun casting rays across the sky.
